prose: Itch.io says it is extending its generative-AI disclosure filtering to a few more places on the site, per the company's Bluesky announcement. Details are thin beyond the one-line post, but the direction continues itch's policy of labeling AI-generated asset disclosure on store pages.
highlights: itch.io extends GenAI disclosure filtering to more areas of the site
One-line Bluesky announcement; details still thin
basis: Thin cache (Bluesky post, ~19 chars extracted). Written from the Hacker News item title and the extracted announcement line only; no article body available.
